note: Product-owned provenance for the ASH branch topology. The shipped topology file is re-hashed at load and fails closed on mismatch; the source identity is the SHA-256 of the pinned ASH-Model archive that the file was extracted from. The authoritative source register is docs/ash-trace/source-to-output-map.md.

sources.role: Canonical semantic branch tree (121 nodes, 81 leaves, depth 0-4, a full ternary tree). Geometric materialization source for the visible glyph: each node carries a 9-bit ASH codeword state, a 4-bit message (the codeword index), 2D segment start/end, heading, segment length, and weight. The 16 distinct node states are the 16 codewords of a [9,4,4] code; the visible glyph projects a deterministic branch fan selected by the profile's decoded ASH message.
